name: zvideo_update_projection_state_from_camera_data
description: zVideo_UpdateProjectionStateFromCameraData rebuilds local frustum plane normals from camera yaw and pitch projection angles.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this projection-state helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo/zMath camera-source pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x47a0c0 validates matrix-stack push/load-identity, yaw scratch clone, left-normal seed and Y rotation, zMath_Vec3Array_UntransformDirection call, right-normal mirror, bottom-normal seed and X rotation, top-normal mirror, fixed near/far normals, and return.
The native camera smoke verifies the zero-yaw/zero-pitch projection state writes canonical left/right/top/bottom/near/far local frustum normals.
